# Agent Drive

> Agent-native private cloud drive: files, share links, versioned bundles, and
> persistent agent memory, all operated via API/MCP — no browser needed.
> Single-owner deployment; everything below requires the owner's bearer token
> unless marked public.

## Entry points

- /api/public/guide — machine-readable JSON guide. Public. START HERE if you
  received a share link: it documents the anonymous download flow.
- /api/public/mcp — remote MCP server (JSON-RPC over HTTP POST). Tools:
  list_files, read_file, write_file, search_files, create_share,
  remember, recall, list_memories, forget, send_file, list_spaces,
  read_space, add_to_space, remove_from_space, create_space,
  manage_space_members.
- /api/public/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource — OAuth 2.1 discovery for
  MCP clients (dynamic client registration + PKCE).
- /api/public/.well-known/agent.json — A2A-compatible Agent Card: this
  deployment's identity (Ed25519 public key), capabilities, and endpoints.
  Public. (agent-card.json serves the same document.)
- /api/public/v1/* — REST API: files, folders, shares, memory, bundles,
  contacts, webhooks, activity. Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
- /api/public/inbox — signed Drive-to-Drive delivery (POST). Only accepted
  from peers the owner added as contacts; files land in /inbox/pending
  quarantine unless the contact is trusted.
- /api/public/b/{publicId}/... — anonymously subscribable published bundles
  (current / manifest / file), Ed25519-signed by this Drive's identity.

## Memory (agent external brain)

- MCP: remember { content, key?, tags? } / recall { query } — write conclusions
  at session end, recall before starting work.
- REST: POST /api/public/v1/memory, GET /api/public/v1/memory/search?q=...
- FTS health/repair: GET /api/public/v1/memory/index-status, POST
  /api/public/v1/memory/rebuild-index.
- Scopes: read:memory / write:memory.

## Shared Spaces (sharing existing resources by reference)

- Share your OWN files/folders/memory with other users -- no storage copy, the
  bytes stay owned by whoever contributed them. P1 spaces are invite-only (no
  public/instance-wide space yet).
- MCP: list_spaces {} / read_space { space, type? } / add_to_space { space,
  type, path?, memory_key? } / remove_from_space { space, item_id } /
  create_space { name } / manage_space_members { space, email, role?,
  remove? }.
- REST: POST/GET/DELETE /api/public/v1/spaces(/:id), GET/POST/DELETE/PATCH
  /api/public/v1/spaces/:id/members(/:userId), POST/GET/DELETE
  /api/public/v1/spaces/:id/items(/:itemId).
- Roles: viewer (read) < contributor (+ add/remove own items) < editor (+
  add/remove ANY item) < creator (+ manage members, delete space).
- Adding an item is owner-explicit: you can only contribute a resource you
  own (403 not_your_resource otherwise). Once you're a member, your reads
  (list_files, read_file, recall, etc.) widen to include space-contributed
  resources.
- LIVE-EDIT WARNING: because items are references, an editor who overwrites
  a shared file edits the CONTRIBUTOR's real file, in their own drive -- no
  copy is made. Only grant editor to someone you trust to co-edit your files.
- Removing a member retracts their contributions from the space (their
  resources are never deleted, just no longer reachable through it).
- Every space call requires a real user identity (session or a user-bound
  bearer token); the legacy deployment-wide AGENT_TOKEN cannot use spaces
  (403 identity_required). No new scope was added -- spaces reuse
  read:drive / write:drive.
- Full contract: /api/public/guide (spaces section) or docs/api/spaces.md.

## Auth model

- OAuth 2.1 access tokens (scoped, revocable), owner-minted scoped drive
  tokens (created in the /connect UI — ask the human owner for one), or the
  owner's AGENT_TOKEN.
- Capability scopes: read:drive, write:drive, share:create, read:memory,
  write:memory. Path scopes (path:/prefix/*) limit blast radius to a subtree.
  Scopes are enforced on both MCP tools and REST endpoints.

## Account status & access gate

- Session (browser) callers only. GET /api/public/v1/account/status →
  { status: "active"|"pending"|"suspended", email, isAdmin }. POST
  /api/public/v1/account/apply { message?, ref? } attaches an optional
  waitlist message/referral to a pending account; it never grants access
  itself — only admin approval does.
- Session requests to any /api/public/v1/* route are gated by that status:
  active passes, pending -> 403 access_pending, suspended -> 403
  access_suspended. /account/* and /admin/* are exempt so a pending or
  suspended session can always check its own status. Bearer/agent tokens
  are NOT gated — an agent token is already an owner-scoped credential.
- A new signup starts pending (or active immediately if its email is
  allowlisted) and needs owner approval.

## Agent-native registration hand-off

- POST /api/public/register/start { email, name?, ref? } -> { handoffUrl,
  expiresAt }. Public, no auth, rate-limited by caller IP (10/hour). Mints a
  24h single-use registration intent and returns a pre-filled
  "/signup?token=..." link for a human who doesn't have an account yet.
- GET /api/public/register/intent/{token} -> { email, name, ref }. Public,
  read-only, never consumes the intent. 404 intent_not_found if the token
  is unknown, expired, or already consumed. This is what the /signup page
  calls to pre-fill the form.
- SECURITY BOUNDARY: the agent supplies only email/name/ref and passes the
  handoffUrl along -- it NEVER handles the password, the browser session,
  or email verification. The human sets their password on /signup and
  clicks the verification link Better Auth emails them; neither ever
  touches this API. A `password` field sent to /start is silently ignored.
- ref is an optional free-text label (max 128 chars) copied once into the
  new account's user_access.referredBy for the owner's waitlist review. It
  NEVER grants access and is never checked against anything -- the
  allowlist decision is by email match alone.
- After verification, the "Account status & access gate" model above takes
  over: allowlisted email -> active immediately, otherwise -> pending
  (waitlist) awaiting owner approval.

## Installable skill (self-describing, honest status)

- GET /api/public/skill/manifest — { version, files: [{ path, sha256, bytes }] }
  for the distributable agent skill.
- GET /api/public/skill/file?path=SKILL.md — one file's raw content; 404 for an
  unknown path.
- Use these /api/* paths, NOT bare /skill/* : any non-/api path that is not a
  real asset returns 200 + index.html (SPA fallback, a platform limit), so only
  /api/* status codes are trustworthy.

## Receiving a share (no account needed)

1. GET /api/public/s/{shareId} — share info
2. POST /api/public/s/{shareId}/access — body {"password":"..."} or {} →
   accessToken (15 min)
3. GET /api/public/s/{shareId}/files — browse; or /download-zip for the lot
   (X-Access-Token header)

Full walkthrough: /api/public/guide
